title: Performance Core
description: No-compromises optimization modpack focused on maximizing performance and smooth gameplay. Perfect for standalone use or alongside other modpacks. Available for Forge and Fabric!
body:
# Performance Core

> Modern Minecraft optimization suite focused on smooth gameplay, improved stability, and better overall performance.

---

Performance Core is a modern optimization modpack for Minecraft designed to improve overall game performance, reduce lag, and deliver a smoother gameplay experience without changing vanilla mechanics.

The modpack focuses on improving frame rates, optimizing memory usage, reducing loading times, and increasing general game responsiveness for both low-end and mid-range systems.

---

## Optimization & Compatibility

Performance Core works well as a standalone optimization solution while also remaining highly compatible with larger modpacks and custom gameplay setups.

For heavily modded instances, players can expect improved stability, smoother chunk loading, reduced stuttering, and better overall performance during gameplay. Even in lighter setups, Performance Core helps free up system resources, allowing Minecraft to run more efficiently and consistently.

---

## Designed For Modded Gameplay

The modpack is built with compatibility in mind and is suitable for a wide range of modded gameplay scenarios, including Vanilla+, RPG, magic, tech, and adventure-focused modpacks.

---

## Supported Versions

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge
- Fabric
